Name: Dino Nugget Pepper Rex
Author: TheRedStarfish
Description:
This mod changes the appearance of the pepper rex monster in the Skull Caverns into a tasty dino nugget!

Requires Content Patcher and SMAPI

You can also enable or disable the mod by using the Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM), where you can find it listed under "Dino Nuggie Pepper Rex".






[size=1]This is my first mod (so please be kind!)[/size]
